newsitem.title: USA: Elephant & Castle, Rainforest in venture.
newsitem.headline: Elephant & Castle, Rainforest in venture.

text.p: Elephant & Castle Group Inc said on Thursday that it has a letter of intent to form a joint venture with Rainforest Cafe to develop at least five Rainforest Cafe retail units in Canada.
The Canadian development will be completed through a new company that is 51 percent owned by Elephant & Castle and 49 percent owned by Rainforest Cafe.
The deal includes a five year option for Rainforest Cafe to buy up to 600,000 Elephant & Castle common stock at $8 per share, as well as an initial fee payable to Rainforest Cafe, it said.
A spokeswoman for Elephant & Castle said the initial fee was $250,000 and the company currently had 2,675,000 shares outstanding.
If Rainforest elects to exercise all of its options, it will own a proforma 18 percent of the enlarged equity base, she said.
She also said Elephant & Castle's share of the investment for the Canadian outlets would be $10-$15 million.
The stock of Elephant & Castle, which operates 21 pubs and restaurants, resumed after a trading halt on Nasdaq 3/4 lower at 7-1/4.
Rainforest Cafe owns and operates combination restaurant-shops on a rain forest theme of "A Wild Place to Shop and Eat." Its stock was 1/2 higher at 32-3/4.
